# OmoGiwa

> OmoGiwa is the personal portfolio and creative technology website of Omogbolahan Giwa, a multidisciplinary designer and software engineer.

## About Omogbolahan Giwa

Omogbolahan Giwa is a multidisciplinary designer and software engineer with a background in Human Anatomy.

He studied Human Anatomy at Gregory University Uturu and earned a bachelor's degree (BSc).

OmoGiwa represents his approach to combining design, software, experimentation, science, and creative problem-solving rather than being confined to a single discipline.

The website serves as both a personal portfolio and an evolving collection of digital experiments, software tools, creative work, and ideas.

[About OmoGiwa](https://omogiwa.com/about)

## Website

The OmoGiwa website contains information about Omogbolahan Giwa, his work, creative projects, software experiments, and tools.

## Tools

OmoGiwa creates interactive browser-based tools and experiments as part of the OG Tools collection.

### Frame Picker

Frame Picker is a browser-based tool that allows users to upload a video, inspect its frames, select frames, and export selected frames. It is designed as an accessible web-based alternative to requiring dedicated video-editing software for simple frame extraction tasks.

[Frame Picker](https://omogiwa.com/tools/frame-picker)

## Design & Creative Work

OmoGiwa's work spans digital design, interface design, visual experimentation, creative technology, and software development.

The website itself is an ongoing demonstration of this multidisciplinary approach, combining custom visual design, interactive interfaces, motion, typography, and software.

[Work](https://omogiwa.com/work)

## Technology

The OmoGiwa website is built with Next.js and React using JavaScript/JSX.

The site uses the Next.js App Router and CSS for styling. It is deployed using Vercel.

The project also includes browser-based JavaScript functionality and uses JSZip for ZIP-file generation in tools such as Frame Picker.

## Design Language

The OmoGiwa visual identity combines a predominantly clean, white interface with dark typography, purple accents, subtle red accents, gradients, motion, and interactive visual elements.

The site uses the Outfit typeface.

The design philosophy favors expressive interaction and personality while maintaining a clean and functional interface.
